question: At the 91st Oscar Awards, which of the following received the Best Picture award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Green Book**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Green Book won the Best Picture award at the 91st Academy Awards in 2019: 
 
 
• The movie about a white chauffeur and his Black client in the segregated United States also won Best Supporting Actor for Mahershala Ali and Best Original Screenplay.
 
 
 
• Green Book overcame mixed reviews and awards-season setbacks to win the top prize. 
 
• Other winners at the 91st Academy Awards included:
 
 
• Bohemian Rhapsody: Won the most awards of the night, with four 
 
• Black Panther: Won three awards 
 
• Roma: Won three awards 
 
• Regina King: Won Supporting Actress for her role in If Beale Street Could Talk 
 
• Free Solo: Won Best Documentary Feature
